label: miso 67 stgas p25
definition: miso-67 (main) -- ST_GAS p25-LEVEL commitment floor: the miso-66 keeper recipe with the st_gas_mustrun_per_plant floor LEVEL swapped from the committed tranche (P5-of-online = LSL) to the plant's measured p25-of-online available-CF x nameplate (thermal_tranches_MISO.csv p25_cf; same frozen estimator, same window, same mechanism id -- rule 19 level replace). The measured 25th-percentile dispatch level of the Entergy MISO-South VLR steam fleet (Sabine 32.9%, Harding Street 36.7%, Nine Mile 49.4%), which ran 30-67% CF despite local LMP at/below SRMC (out-of-market VLR -- Amite South / DSG / WOTAB, MISO SOM). Zero fitted scalars. base = unchanged-recipe same-box drift control (mechanism-only = main - base). No ablation twin (rule 20 amended 2026-07-14). Design: docs/handoffs/miso-run66-triage-design-2026-07.md Issue-2. RE-SOLVE on the fixed CC base (supersedes the 2026-07-15 registration of this bundle, which was solved on a regressed main): the CC_REGULAR-2023 regression vs the miso-66 solve commit was bisected to the always-on EIA-860 CC summer-capacity guard (d7cc13a/e3b575e) biting MISO without the raise-side demonstrated-peak protection every other synthesized-bins ISO received; fixed by re-deriving cc_capacity_reconcile_MISO.csv with --mode both (16 measured raise rows, caps byte-identical). C1 all 15/16 — ST_GAS-2024 FIXED by the p25 level (-6.59 PASS, was the miso-66 sole fail -9.13); sole remaining C1 fail CC_REGULAR-2023 (-9.79, volume): the honest measured fleet exposes the pre-existing Cottonwood (55358) status under-carry (~570 MW OP in the 2023/24 EIA-860 vintages, OA in the current snapshot - invisible to both the OP filter and the retired-within-window channel), its own lane.
market_story: One measured layer on the miso-66 recipe, zero fitted parameters: MISO-South Entergy steam plants (Sabine, Harding Street, Nine Mile, Lewis Creek) ran 30-67% of capacity through 2023-2025 even when the local price sat at or below their fuel cost - out-of-market voltage-and-local-reliability commitments the MISO market monitor documents (Amite South / DSG / WOTAB). The miso-66 floor held them only at their minimum-stable-load (the 5th-percentile of when-online output); this run swaps that level to each plant's measured 25th-percentile-of-online output (the thermal-tranche artifact's p25_cf x nameplate, the same frozen CAMPD estimator - no deriver touch, no tuned scalar). Solved on the FIXED CC capability base (cc_capacity_reconcile_MISO --mode both: measured demonstrated peaks now protect and extend 16 plants; the guard's clips at Nine Mile/Perryville stand as genuine EIA-860 double-filing). Mechanism-only vs the same-box unchanged-recipe base: ST_GAS +3.6/+3.5/+5.0 TWh across 2023/24/25, flipping ST_GAS-2024 from the miso-66 sole C1 fail to PASS (-6.59); coal/CC/CT give up 0.2-1.9 TWh each; the price-shape veto holds (2025 NRMSE 0.193 <= 0.20). The forced share climbs above the 30% budget (32.8/34.5/50.2%) but GROUNDS clean on shape + window (D-1 diurnal r 0.982-0.986, D-4 zero off-window binding) - the NYISO reliability-base precedent. C1 all 15/16: the sole fail is CC_REGULAR-2023 (-9.79), the honest-fleet read of a pre-existing under-carry (Cottonwood 55358's four OA-status units, ~570 MW, ran through 2023-24 but are dropped by the snapshot OP filter) that the removed phantom capacity used to mask - a named fleet-vintage lane, not this mechanism. C3a-2025/C3c stay the parked price-formation lane (F4-blocked on OASIS max-gen event access).
